changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE app.OutboxMessages ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, MessageType NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, Payload NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL, AvailableAtUtc DATETIME2 NOT NULL, Status NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, AttemptCount INT NOT NULL, CorrelationId NVARCHAR(100) NULL, IdempotencyKey NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, CreatedAtUtc DATETIME2 NOT NULL, ProcessedAtUtc DATETIME2 NULL, LastError NVARCHAR(500) NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_OutboxMessages PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_OutboxMessages_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_OutboxMessages_Status CHECK (Status IN (N'Pending', N'Dispatched', N'Cancelled')), CONSTRAINT UX_OutboxMessages_TenantId_IdempotencyKey UNIQUE (TenantId, IdempotencyKey) ); CREATE INDEX IX_OutboxMessages_Status_CreatedAtUtc ON app.OutboxMessages (Status, CreatedAtUtc);
